metadata.title: SSPP Instance – Trusted Cloud (Envoke)
metadata.remarks: Updated SSPP instance evaluating Envoke as a third‑party SaaS platform under institutional Trusted Cloud governance. Incorporates clarified tenant isolation, logging constraints, and API key lifecycle characteristics.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative platform trust, governance, and assessment expectations defined in the Trusted Cloud SSPP Template.

system-characteristics.system-description: Third-party SaaS platform providing multi-tenant email campaign management services to institutional customers.

props.name: institutional-owner
props.remarks: Institutional and business owner responsible for campaign governance and acceptance of residual platform risk.

props.name: technical-owner
props.remarks: Technical owner responsible for SSO configuration, authorization administration, and platform operations.

props.name: isolation-boundary
props.remarks: Each Envoke account represents a fully isolated tenant.

props.name: data-segmentation-model
props.remarks: All users within an account share a single dataset; no cross-account or intra-account data partitioning exists.

props.name: cross-account-sharing
props.remarks: No sharing of data, contacts, audiences, campaigns, or authorized senders between accounts.

props.name: branding-template-sharing
props.remarks: A root account may share branding templates with subaccounts. Sharing is content-only and does not create data plane linkage.

props.name: authorization-scope
props.remarks: Roles limit available actions within an account but do not restrict access to the account dataset.

props.name: data-residency
props.remarks: Customer data, backups, and primary service hosting are located in Canada.

props.name: data-sovereignty
props.remarks: The service is operated by a Canadian company subject to Canadian jurisdiction.

props.name: independent-assurance
props.remarks: Provider maintains independent SOC 2 assurance, referenced through procurement and risk processes.

props.name: logging-scope
props.remarks: Administrative action logs are available to tenant administrators. Campaign logs and telemetry are available to users within their respective accounts.

props.name: log-exportability
props.remarks: Logs cannot currently be exported for external correlation. A provider security API is planned to enable log collection and SIEM integration.

props.name: api-credential-model
props.remarks: Each Envoke account uses a single API key for data and application integrations.

props.name: api-key-access-scope
props.remarks: The account API key may be retrieved by certain non-administrative roles.

props.name: api-key-rotation-impact
props.remarks: Rotating the API key invalidates all integrations for the account simultaneously.

props.name: api-key-management-maturity
props.remarks: Per-integration keys and granular rotation are not currently supported. A future security API and enhancements are planned.

props.name: subprocessor-transparency
props.remarks: Use of subprocessors is disclosed by the provider with change notification.

props.name: data-exit-support
props.remarks: Provider supports data export and contractually commits to data deletion upon termination.

components.title: Envoke SaaS Platform
components.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform operated by Envoke hosting institutional email campaign workloads.
components.remarks: This SSPP instance evaluates Envoke at the platform trust level only. Identity, email security, and application behavior are addressed by separate SSPPs.

control-implementation.remarks: Trusted Cloud controls are satisfied through inherited template expectations and provider-supplied disclosures, attestations, and contractual commitments. Known observability and API key lifecycle limitations are declared to drive governance-focused findings.
